description:
**Phase G — Tree session integration. Deps: G3, G5c.**

Add `/tree` to `OctoPi.Coder.Extensions.Commands`. Opens the tree-selector UI (G5c), captures user selection + summary choice, triggers `Session.navigate_tree/2` (G2), which leads to `BranchSummaryEntry` append (G3).

Tests: command parser + integration smoke through the full tree-nav flow.
